faq.title: Before You Begin
faq.quote: Ask freely, clarity is itself a first remedy.

items.q: Who is the best astrologer in Chennai?
items.a: The word best is personal and should be approached with care. Anugraha Jyothishalaya is led by Govindan Namboodiri VG, whose practice is shaped by a five-generation lineage of temple astrologers and traditional Sastric grounding. Clients usually choose the practice for its calm, disciplined readings and practical remedies.

items.q: Where can I find a reliable astrologer in Perambur, Chennai?
items.a: Anugraha Jyothishalaya is located at Flat No. 6, Saravana Villa, Meenakshi Street, Perambur, Chennai 600011. Consultations are handled by appointment, with horoscope reading, Nadi guidance, marriage matching, Vaasthu, numerology, and parihara rituals offered with discretion.

items.q: What makes Anugraha Jyothishalaya different from other astrologers in Chennai?
items.a: The practice keeps to traditional Jyotisha and Sastric methods rather than sensational claims. Readings consider the birth chart, dasha, transits, family context, and remedies that can realistically be followed.

items.q: How much does a Nadi astrology consultation cost in Chennai?
items.a: The fee depends on whether you need a standard consultation, a dedicated Nadi session, or follow-up guidance alongside the reading. Share your concern and birth details, and the appropriate format and fee will be confirmed before booking.

items.q: Is Nadi astrology accurate?
items.a: Nadi reading is approached with reverence and care. Its value lies in whether the reading resonates clearly with your life, timing, and questions, and it is best received as guidance rather than spectacle.

items.q: What does a Vedic astrologer in Chennai do?
items.a: A Vedic astrologer studies the birth chart, planetary periods, transits, and relevant remedies to clarify patterns around marriage, career, family, health, and spiritual practice.

items.q: How do I book an astrologer consultation in Perambur?
items.a: You can request an appointment through the form on this page or by WhatsApp. Once your name, contact number, and consultation details are received, a suitable time will be confirmed.

items.q: Do you provide marriage matching astrology in Chennai?
items.a: Yes. Marriage matching consultations compare horoscope compatibility, timing, family considerations, and remedial guidance where needed. The reading is intended to support careful decisions, not to create fear.

items.q: Can I consult for career, business, or property decisions?
items.a: Yes. Many clients seek guidance for career movement, business timing, property decisions, and Vaasthu concerns. The consultation studies planetary periods and practical timing before suggesting a path.

items.q: Are online astrology consultations available for clients outside Chennai?
items.a: Yes. Consultations can be arranged by phone or secure video call for clients outside Chennai and India. Birth details and the main question are shared before the appointment.

items.q: What details do I need to share before a horoscope consultation?
items.a: Please share your date of birth, exact time of birth as closely as possible, and place of birth. If the birth time is uncertain, a rectification session can be arranged first.

items.q: Are remedies and parihara rituals difficult to follow?
items.a: Remedies are prescribed with practicality in mind. Some may be as simple as daily mantra japa, while others may involve temple worship on specific days.

items.q: Is my consultation confidential?
items.a: Yes. Personal details, charts, questions, and remedies are treated with discretion and remain private between you and the astrologer.

items.q: Do you offer follow-up consultations after the first reading?
items.a: Yes. Many people return during major dasha changes, before marriage discussions, house decisions, or other important life transitions.
